title: Maximum Weight in Two Bags
summary: Given an array of item weights and the maximum capacities of two bags, determine the greatest total weight that can be packed into both bags, with each item placed in at most one bag and not exceeding the respective bag's weight limit.
statement: Given an array of item weights and the maximum capacities of two bags, determine the greatest total weight that can be packed into both bags, with each item placed in at most one bag and not exceeding the respective bag's weight limit.
constraints: Each capacity is between one and 300.
Each item may be used in at most one bag.
hints: The state is the best packed weight for a pair of remaining capacity bounds.
Use two-dimensional 0/1 knapsack and iterate both capacities downward per item.
For each item, keep the state or place it in exactly one bag when it fits.
Descending updates ensure every transition reads the prior-item layer, so no item is reused and all legal assignments are represented.
editorial: Descending updates ensure every transition reads the prior-item layer, so no item is reused and all legal assignments are represented.

tests.explanation: Pack three plus two in the first bag and four in the second for nine.
Neither item fits either capacity, so the result is zero.
